status: SIMULATED — stipulated parameters; not calibrated; not evidence

parameter_vector.X14_window: annual changes Delta A_t for t=1..T*, T* = crossing year, or t=79 if right-censored; SD (ddof=1) of those changes
parameter_vector.demand_path_note: Stipulated recursion d_{t+1}=d_t*r*(1-d_t/dmax) with r=0.08 (<1) is contractive: d_t decays monotonically from 0.10 and stays below 0.50 for all t, so no crossing can occur under the frozen parameters; all cells are fully right-censored (>80) and censored medians are reported as undefined, never imputed.

rng.seed_formula: seed = 20261120 + 1000000*block + seed_index; block 1 = X13/X14, block 2 = X15
rng.call_pattern: Per seed one uniform draw of size K_MAX=32 for X13/X14 (cell K uses first K entries -> paired across K); for X15 one uniform draw of size 8 plus one rng.permutation(8) per seed to choose binding markets.

reproducibility: Deterministic: fixed seeds, fixed demand path, no observed data read. Re-running code/run.py must reproduce results CSVs byte-identically.
